=== PAGE 1 ===
LAST WILL AND TESTAMENT OF MARIA LOPEZ

I, Maria Lopez, of Austin, Texas, being of sound mind, declare this to be my Last Will and Testament and revoke all prior wills and codicils.

ARTICLE I. FAMILY
I am married to Daniel Lopez. I have one child, Sofia Lopez.

ARTICLE II. DISPOSITION OF ESTATE
I give my entire estate to my husband, Daniel Lopez, if he survives me. If he does not survive me, I give my entire estate to my daughter, Sofia Lopez.

ARTICLE III. EXECUTOR
I appoint my husband, Daniel Lopez, as Independent Executor of this Will. If he is unable to serve, I appoint my daughter, Sofia Lopez, as Independent Executor. No bond shall be required.

ARTICLE IV. GOVERNING LAW
This Will shall be governed by the laws of the State of Texas.

Signed on August 21, 2023, in Austin, Texas.

/s/ Maria Lopez
Maria Lopez, Testator

/s/ Kevin Brandt, Witness
/s/ Priya Natarajan, Witness
